name: Flying Sparks

gist.Sparkfly Queen: Only arrives through Hive's Crown. Each turn Mika names a card type and you must pick cards of that type out of your own deck and hand them to her, one for every Sparkfly she controls.
gist.Hive's Crown: Sacrifices a Sparkfly to put the Queen in its place: from hand, or from the deck if the Sparkfly had survived a turn.
gist.Sparkfly Architect: Fetches a Sparkfly card or the Crown on arrival.
gist.Sparkfly Attendant: While it stands, your cards and effects cannot touch the Queen.
gist.Sparkfly Worker: With the Queen out, returns a non-hero card on the board to hand when it arrives.
gist.Enigma, the Seller of Secrets: Each turn reveals the top five cards of your deck and takes one of them; you put the rest back.
gist.Lilly, the Charming Infiltrator: Draws a card every time Mika takes a card from your deck or hand.
gist.Alice, the Puppeteer Girl: Once per turn hits a target, harder for every creature that has stayed on her board.
gist.Performance: Ability that raises the one beneath it a level.
gist.Booby Trap: Face-down trap that punishes the attacker.
gist.Fireshield: Reaction: returns part of a hit.
gist.Deepsea Idol: Cancels a sweep on two or more creatures.

plan: Mika builds a hive and then shops in your deck. Architects find the pieces, a Sparkfly that has survived a turn is crowned, and the Queen comes out of the deck. From then on Mika names a card type each turn and you have to hand her cards of that type out of your own deck, while Enigma takes the best of your top five; Lilly draws a card for every one of those thefts, and Alice turns the hive into damage. The hive is small creatures all the way down: the Queen cannot arrive without a Sparkfly to crown, and the Attendant that shields her has no shield of its own.

looks.early: Two Sparkflies and a Ska Harpyformer; a Hive's Crown in her hand.
looks.mid: The Queen with an Attendant at her side, your deck getting thinner in exactly the wrong places, your cards in her hand.
looks.late: A full hive, Alice counting it, and Mika reading the top of your deck with a sleepy smile.

opening.tell: She has small Sparkflies on the board and no Queen yet.
opening.why: The Crown needs a Sparkfly to sacrifice, and one that has survived a turn to fetch the Queen from the deck; a sweep now delays the hive by several turns.

midgame.tell: A Sparkfly Attendant stands next to the Queen.
midgame.why: The Attendant makes the Queen untouchable and is itself an ordinary small creature: remove it first, then the Queen falls to The Yeeting or Dark Gear. Every turn she lives, key cards leave your deck.

crisis.tell: Your deck has lost most of its Destruction Magic; what you hold is what you have.
crisis.why: The long game is gone with the deck, so the cards in hand must become hero damage now; her hive is too well protected to be worth them.

endgame.tell: Alice and a few Sparkflies are her remaining damage; her heroes are ordinary.
endgame.why: Blunt the one hit that would kill each turn and spend everything else on heroes; there is no deck left to dig through.

opening.board: Mika summons a Sparkfly Architect, which fetches a Hive's Crown, and a Ska Harpyformer.
Enigma turns over your top five cards and takes the best one; Lilly draws for it.
